# SEC filing: filing (FILING)

One SEC filing: its company, form, dates, 8-K items and its links on EDGAR (metadata only; the document stays on sec.gov). One row per sec filing, keyed by ACCESSION. Read by the **us-equities** pack's connector `us-equities-store` (table `<root>/us-equities/filing/`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-24 from SEC EDGAR, Nasdaq Trader, GLEIF and Wikidata (tools/publicdata/us_equities.py), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 11,691 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/us-equities/filing/` + `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `ACCESSION` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `ACCESSION`, `COMPANY`, `COMPANY_NAME`, `FORM`, `FILED`, `REPORT_DATE` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 11,691 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

```json
{
  "ACCESSION": "0001104659-26-117587",
  "COMPANY": "ABT",
  "COMPANY_NAME": "Abbott Laboratories",
  "FORM": "8-K",
  "FORM_NAME": "Current report",
  "FILED": "2026-10-21",
  "REPORT_DATE": "2026-10-21",
  "PRIMARY_DOCUMENT": "tm2627971d1_8k.htm",
  "DOCUMENT_DESCRIPTION": "FORM 8-K",
  "SIZE_KB": 278,
  "ITEMS": [
    {
      "ITEM": "8.01",
      "DESCRIPTION": "Other events"
    },
    {
      "ITEM": "9.01",
      "DESCRIPTION": "Financial statements and exhibits"
    }
  ],
  "ITEMS_TEXT": "8.01, 9.01",
  "PATH": "1800/000110465926117587",
  "_meta": {
    "source": "sec-edgar",
    "dataset": "submissions (recent filings)",
    "retrievedAt": "2026-10-24",
    "generation": 1
  }
}
```

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ACCESSION` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^[0-9]{10}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{6}$` | `"0001104659-26-117587"` |
| `COMPANY` | string | required | The filer: a TICKER of the us-company kind. | links to `us-company` | `"ABT"` |
| `COMPANY_NAME` | string | required | The filer's name as the pack shows it (Wikidata's label, else EDGAR's name). | — | `"Abbott Laboratories"` |
| `FORM` | string | required | The EDGAR form type as filed (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4, 144, DEF 14A …). | — | `"8-K"` |
| `FORM_NAME` | string | required | The form type in words (8-K: Current report; 4: Change in beneficial ownership (insider)); the form type itself when the pack has no wording. | — | `"Current report"` |
| `FILED` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the filing was accepted by EDGAR (filingDate), YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-21"` |
| `REPORT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in 75% of rows) | The period or event date the filing reports on (EDGAR reportDate), YYYY-MM-DD; absent when EDGAR gives none. | — | `"2026-10-21"` |
| `PRIMARY_DOCUMENT` | string | required | The file name of the filing's primary document on EDGAR (EDGAR primaryDocument). | — | `"tm2627971d1_8k.htm"` |
| `DOCUMENT_DESCRIPTION` | string | required | EDGAR's description of the primary document (primaryDocDescription). | — | `"FORM 8-K"` |
| `SIZE_KB` | integer | required | The filing's size on EDGAR, in kilobytes (rounded). | unit: KB | `278` |
| `ITEMS` | array of objects | required (filled in 14% of rows) | For an 8-K, the items it reports, one element each: ITEM (8.01) and DESCRIPTION (Other events); empty for other forms. | — | [2 objects] |
| `ITEMS[].ITEM` | string | required | The 8-K item number (EDGAR items), as text ("2.02"). | — | `"8.01"` |
| `ITEMS[].DESCRIPTION` | string | optional (filled in over 99% of `ITEMS[]` entries) | The item in words (2.02: Results of operations and financial condition); absent for an item the pack has no wording for. | — | `"Other events"` |
| `ITEMS_TEXT` | string | optional (filled in 14% of rows) | The 8-K item numbers the filing reports, comma separated (8.01, 9.01); empty for other forms. | — | `"8.01, 9.01"` |
| `PATH` | string | required | The filing's folder on EDGAR: <CIK without leading zeros>/<accession without dashes> (under https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/). | — | `"1800/000110465926117587"` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"sec-edgar"` |
| `_meta.dataset` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source's data set the record was read from. | — | `"submissions (recent filings)"` |
| `_meta.retrievedAt` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The date the source data was retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-24"` |
| `_meta.generation` | integer | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The generator's format generation (always 1). | — | `1` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 11,691 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `ACCESSION` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `ACCESSION`, `COMPANY`, `COMPANY_NAME`, `FORM`, `FORM_NAME`, `FILED`, `PRIMARY_DOCUMENT`, `DOCUMENT_DESCRIPTION`, `SIZE_KB`, `ITEMS`, `PATH` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `ACCESSION` per snapshot.
- `ACCESSION` matches `^[0-9]{10}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{6}$`.
